title: 清楚了解剪貼簿輔助選字與 Sublime 整合
summary: 相容性設定改用具體名稱，說明何時暫借剪貼簿，以及 Sublime 首次啟用時會設定什麼。
highlights: 「選字相容模式」更名為「允許剪貼簿輔助選字」，保留剪貼簿歷程提醒。
「Sublime 支援」更名為「Sublime Text 整合」，相關提示同步更新；開關行為與已保存的選擇維持原樣。
usage: 開啟設定的「相容性」頁面即可查看新名稱。Sublime Text 整合仍需先開啟剪貼簿輔助選字，首次啟用會設定專用快捷鍵。

en.title: Clearer clipboard-assisted selection and Sublime integration settings
en.summary: Compatibility settings now explain when SnapBar temporarily uses the clipboard and what first-time Sublime setup configures.
highlights: Selection compatibility mode is now Allow clipboard-assisted selection, with the clipboard history notice retained.
Sublime support is now Sublime Text integration, with matching messages; toggle behavior and saved choices remain unchanged.
en.usage: Open Compatibility in Settings to see the new names. Sublime Text integration still requires clipboard-assisted selection and configures dedicated shortcuts when first enabled.
